scenes.heading: EXT. LLANGANATES MOUNTAINS — SOME WEEKS LATER

beats.text: CHASKA, alone, climbs a ridge line. ATOC waits at the top, looking out over the valley toward a distant, smoke-thinned Quito.

beats.speaker: Atoc
beats.text: You didn't need to come all the way up here to tell me.

beats.speaker: Chaska
beats.text: I didn't come to tell you. You already knew before I got here. I came because I didn't want to hear it alone.
(A long silence. Wind. Atoc looks back toward the mountains behind them — the hidden treasure's direction, never shown directly on screen even now.)

beats.speaker: Atoc
beats.text: Three of us knew where that gold went. Now it's two.

beats.speaker: Chaska
beats.text: Then it stays two. However long that takes.

beats.speaker: Atoc
beats.direction: almost a dry laugh, no real humor in it
beats.text: He'd have liked that. Something of his that even they can't touch.

beats.speaker: Chaska
beats.direction: looking at the mountains, not at Atoc
beats.text: He'd have liked a lot of things he didn't get.
final short walking sequence — the player, as Chaska, walks the ridge alongside Atoc toward the tree line, no combat, no further dialogue prompts. They disappear into the trees together.
Rumiñahui was executed in June 1535, having never revealed the location of Atahualpa's treasure.
To this day, the gold of the Inca has never been found in the Llanganates — and people are still looking.
